title: Humble Earthy British Shungiku Shepherd's Pie
description: A comforting, earthy vegetarian take on the classic shepherd's pie, featuring tender shungiku and a crispy mashed potato topping, perfect for a cozy British evening.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Sauté the shungiku leaves until wilted, then set aside.
Add the butter to the pan and melt, then add the all-purpose flour and stir to combine.
Cook for 1 minute, then slowly add the vegetable broth, whisking constantly.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened, then stir in the milk and remove from heat.
Add the garlic powder, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the cooked shungiku to the pan and stir to combine, then set aside to cool.
Prepare the mashed potatoes according to your recipe of choice, then spread in an even layer in the bottom of a 9-inch pie dish.
Top the mashed potatoes with the shungiku mixture, then spread the grated cheddar cheese evenly over the top.
Bake the shepherd's pie in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
Serve hot, garnished with additional shungiku leaves if desired.
Let the shepherd's pie rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the filling to set.
